name: Wellnhopterus
sum: Short-faced azhdarchid from the Maastrichtian Javelina Formation of Big Bend, Texas.
holotype: TxVP 42489-2 — Javelina Formation, Big Bend National Park, Texas.
material: Upper and lower jaws, several neck vertebrae and a fragmentary long bone.
biology: Unusually blunt, short jaws for an azhdarchid.
author: Andres and Langston 2021

species.name: Wellnhopterus brevirostris
species.author: Andres and Langston 2021
